## Workflow

### Regenerate

python3 -m soc_generator.pcba_generator <soc-spec.yaml> --output <pcba-dir>

### Headless KiCad export

```bash
cd <pcba-dir>/<target>/
kicad-cli sch erc     <soc>_<target>.kicad_sch -o reports/erc.json
kicad-cli pcb drc     <soc>_<target>.kicad_pcb -o reports/drc.json
kicad-cli sch export bom     <soc>_<target>.kicad_sch -o bom/<soc>_<target>_bom.csv
kicad-cli pcb export gerbers <soc>_<target>.kicad_pcb -o gerbers/
kicad-cli pcb export drill   <soc>_<target>.kicad_pcb -o gerbers/
kicad-cli pcb export step    <soc>_<target>.kicad_pcb -o <soc>_<target>.step
```
